candidate_documents_publish_requires_rig.name: candidate_documents_publish_requires_rights_check
candidate_documents_publish_requires_rig.value:
"candidate_documents"."publication_state" != 'published' OR (
        "candidate_documents"."review_state" = 'approved'
        AND "candidate_documents"."content_snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_documents"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_documents"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_documents"."retention_outcome" = 'stored-publishable'
        AND "candidate_documents"."rights_state" IN ('candidate-permission', 'publisher-permission', 'redistributable')
      )

candidate_media_publish_rights_check.name: candidate_media_publish_rights_check
candidate_media_publish_rights_check.value:
"candidate_media_assets"."publication_state" != 'published' OR (
        "candidate_media_assets"."review_state" = 'approved'
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."content_snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."retention_outcome" = 'stored-publishable'
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."rights_state" IN ('candidate-permission', 'redistributable')
      )
